title: RAM forgets when the power goes

probes.question: What happens to the data in RAM when power is removed?
options: It is saved for a year
It is backed up in the cloud

probes.question: True or false: SSDs rely on non-volatile memory to store data.

image.alt: The back of a green DDR4 memory stick with eight black memory chips and gold edge contacts.

body.claim: RAM is your computer's working memory, and it is wiped when the power goes off.
body.why: RAM can be read and changed in any order and typically holds working data and machine code. Both static and dynamic RAM are volatile, so their state is lost when power is removed. Storage such as an SSD relies on non-volatile memory, which keeps your files.
